verdict.rationale: Unreal exposes official SDK-like surfaces for programmatic/agentic use — C++ API, Python scripting API, Remote Control HTTP/WebSocket API, and command-line automation tools (unreal-docs-2,4,22,24,25) — which an AI-native agent could build against. However, there is no evidence of an official SDK purpose-built for AI/agent integration (no LLM/agent SDK, no official client libraries in languages like Python/JS beyond editor scripting, no documented AI-specific API). missing for 10: dedicated AI-agent SDK or client library, independent hands-on validation of agentic use via these APIs, clearer packaging of these APIs as a unified 'SDK' for external AI tooling.
